_comment: TASK-05-012 baseline, measured 2026-11-04 on the deterministic labeled set in tests/clustering_eval.rs (10 identities x 10 faces + 8 noise faces, min_cluster_size 5). The 8 noise faces coalesce into one spurious cluster, which is the 0.9414 precision — a clustering change that scores below precision_floor/recall_floor is a regression (PLAN §9 AI row).
